title: Scary Movie 5
synopsis: A cabin in the woods, three found children, and a possessed Roomba. You and your spouse just wanted a vacation.

nodes.text: You adopt three found children. They are feral. The Department of Adoptions is, mostly, a sign. Both choices lead to Cabin Reservation, but “Adopt them all” arrives there with a different cost than “Adopt one.”

choices.consequence: You commit to adopt them all. The road to Cabin Reservation is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.
You commit to adopt one. The road to Cabin Reservation is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.

nodes.text: The Airbnb description includes 'minor haunting.' The reviews are, on balance, kind. You cannot avoid Roomba; you can only decide whether “Book it” or “Read the reviews carefully” defines the person who reaches it. By Roomba, somebody will have misunderstood the choice spectacularly.

choices.consequence: You choose to book it. By Roomba, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You commit to read the reviews carefully. The road to Roomba is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.

nodes.text: The Roomba turns itself on at 3 a.m. and chases you. The Roomba is, technically, possessed. Found Footage will follow either decision, but it will meet a different version of you after “Sit on the couch” than after “Run.”

choices.consequence: You choose to sit on the couch. By Found Footage, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You run. It gets you to Found Footage, though not with the dignity or plausible deniability you would have preferred.

nodes.text: Cameras everywhere. The cabin records you constantly. You realize, eventually, this is for a streaming show. Snow White Princess comes either way; its meaning changes with the difference between “Talk to camera” and “Cover the cameras.”

choices.consequence: You commit to talk to camera. The road to Snow White Princess is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.
You cover the cameras. It gets you to Snow White Princess, though not with the dignity or plausible deniability you would have preferred.

nodes.text: A princess shows up. She does, technically, sing. She also, technically, is in a sex scene with a deer. The Children, Feral will follow either decision, but it will meet a different version of you after “Be polite” than after “Decline the dance.”

choices.consequence: You commit to be polite. The road to The Children, Feral is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.
You choose to decline the dance. By The Children, Feral, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.

nodes.text: The children eat your shoes and a cake. The cake was the dog's. The road still runs toward Mama Ghost. Its next turn depends on the difference between choosing “Discipline gently” and choosing “Cry.” At Mama Ghost, the plan may survive even if your dignity does not.

choices.consequence: You choose to discipline gently. By Mama Ghost, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You cry. It gets you to Mama Ghost, though not with the dignity or plausible deniability you would have preferred.

nodes.text: The ghost is named Mama. Mama is, on balance, supportive. She would like, ideally, the cabin returned to her by the weekend. The road still runs toward Black Swan Bit. Its next turn depends on the difference between choosing “Negotiate with Mama” and choosing “Move out.”

choices.consequence: You choose to negotiate with Mama. By Black Swan Bit, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You choose to move out. By Black Swan Bit, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.

nodes.text: A spoof of Black Swan in the bathroom mirror. You realize, briefly, that you are also a spoof of yourself. The road still runs toward Inception Spoof. Its next turn depends on the difference between choosing “Dance” and choosing “Just brush your teeth.”

choices.consequence: You commit to dance. The road to Inception Spoof is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.
You choose to just brush your teeth. By Inception Spoof, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.

nodes.text: A dream-within-a-dream sequence. You wake up six times. The sixth time you actually wake up, you are unsure. Paranormal Activity is already waiting. What changes is whether “Pinch yourself” or “Spin a top” is the instinct you carry into it.

choices.consequence: You choose to pinch yourself. By Paranormal Activity, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You commit to spin a top. The road to Paranormal Activity is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.

nodes.text: A camera in the bedroom records you sleeping. It is, somehow, judging you. Insidious Spoof will follow either decision, but it will meet a different version of you after “Cover the camera” than after “Ignore it.”

choices.consequence: You choose to cover the camera. By Insidious Spoof, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You ignore it. It gets you to Insidious Spoof, though not with the dignity or plausible deniability you would have preferred.

nodes.text: A ghost in the closet wants to know your password. The road still runs toward Sinister. Its next turn depends on the difference between choosing “Change it” and choosing “Give it to the ghost.” At Sinister, the plan may survive even if your dignity does not.

choices.consequence: You choose to change it. By Sinister, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You choose to give it to the ghost. By Sinister, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.

nodes.text: A series of home movies you don't remember filming. They are all of the dog. The dog has, somehow, a secret life. Mama, Reconciled comes either way; its meaning changes with the difference between “Question the dog” and “Just let the dog live.”

choices.consequence: You choose to question the dog. By Mama, Reconciled, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You choose to just let the dog live. By Mama, Reconciled, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.

nodes.text: Mama and you, over tea, reach an understanding. She gets the cabin Tuesdays. You get Wednesdays. The children, somehow, are on board. The road still runs toward Children, Less Feral. Its next turn depends on the difference between choosing “Sign the agreement” and choosing “Send Mama away.”

choices.consequence: You choose to sign the agreement. By Children, Less Feral, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You send Mama away. It gets you to Children, Less Feral, though not with the dignity or plausible deniability you would have preferred.

nodes.text: The children, over time, become children. The cake-eating becomes pie-baking. The shoe-eating becomes, mostly, shoe-tying. You cannot avoid The Streaming Show; you can only decide whether “Take pride” or “Take credit” defines the person who reaches it.

choices.consequence: You choose to take pride. By The Streaming Show, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You choose to take credit. By The Streaming Show, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.

nodes.text: The streaming show airs. You are, on balance, the funny one. The dog is the breakout star. Dance Number is already waiting. What changes is whether “Sign for season two” or “Decline” is the instinct you carry into it.

choices.consequence: You choose to sign for season two. By Dance Number, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You decline. It gets you to Dance Number, though not with the dignity or plausible deniability you would have preferred.

nodes.text: An unnecessary musical dance number. The children participate. The Roomba does a solo. You cannot avoid Final Confrontation; you can only decide whether “Cherish it” or “Pretend it didn't happen” defines the person who reaches it.

choices.consequence: You cherish it. It gets you to Final Confrontation, though not with the dignity or plausible deniability you would have preferred.
You choose to pretend it didn't happen. By Final Confrontation, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.

nodes.text: Mama, the Roomba, the deer, and the dog all stand in the kitchen at the same time. Family photo. The road still runs toward Hospital Sequence. Its next turn depends on the difference between choosing “Take the photo” and choosing “Just be there.”

choices.consequence: You take the photo. It gets you to Hospital Sequence, though not with the dignity or plausible deniability you would have preferred.
You just be there. It gets you to Hospital Sequence, though not with the dignity or plausible deniability you would have preferred.

nodes.text: A bizarre dream-hospital sequence in which nothing means anything and everything is, somehow, funny. Wedding comes either way; its meaning changes with the difference between “Laugh” and “Be confused.” By Wedding, somebody will have misunderstood the choice spectacularly.

choices.consequence: You commit to laugh. The road to Wedding is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.
You commit to be confused. The road to Wedding is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.

nodes.text: You and your spouse, somewhere in the third act, re-marry on a beach. Mama officiates. The Roomba carries the rings. The road still runs toward Bloopers. Its next turn depends on the difference between choosing “Cry” and choosing “Laugh.”

choices.consequence: You commit to cry. The road to Bloopers is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.
You commit to laugh. The road to Bloopers is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.

nodes.text: Bloopers roll. The Roomba refuses to perform. The deer falls asleep on set. You cannot avoid Sequel Hook; you can only decide whether “Stay for bloopers” or “Leave” defines the person who reaches it. In Bloopers, delaying only gives the absurdity time to organize.

choices.consequence: You stay for bloopers. It gets you to Sequel Hook, though not with the dignity or plausible deniability you would have preferred.
You choose to leave. By Sequel Hook, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.

nodes.text: A title card promises another sequel. The dog winks. The Roomba sighs. The paths divide here: “Wink back” leads into Cabin Family, while “Look away” makes Suburbs Again the next reckoning. A third choice, “Take the third path,” keeps The Deer's Spinoff in play.

choices.consequence: You choose to wink back. By Cabin Family, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
You choose to look away. By Suburbs Again, the plan will either look inspired or become a story told at your expense for years.
Some endings reveal themselves last. You commit to take the third path. The road to The Deer's Spinoff is now open, and at least two people are already preparing to misunderstand why.

nodes.text: You keep the cabin. Mama and the dog and the Roomba and the children become, in a real sense, a family. The streaming show runs for six seasons. The road into Cabin Family began with “Wink back” in Sequel Hook; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

You move back to the suburbs. The children, settled, become weirdly normal. You take up gardening. Mama, sometimes, visits. The road into Suburbs Again began with “Look away” in Sequel Hook; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.

The deer, against all reason, gets a spinoff. You serve as executive producer. It is the highest-rated show of the year. Nobody at the Emmys asks you any questions you can answer. The road into The Deer's Spinoff began with “Take the third path” in Sequel Hook; here, that decision stops being a moment and becomes a life.
